summary: P3, I7b deviation, judged acceptable. git_shas() returns HEAD and every parent, so find also looks up the build-native runs of a non-merge commit's single parent. I7b limits the parent lookup to merge commits. Because of this, the scratch docs-only commit (parent c55d95011 has green runs) read tree_mismatch where the brief's Check expected no_run. A non-merge commit whose parent build is still running reads in_progress, although waiting will never produce its tree. Both verdicts fail closed, and the tree_mismatch prescription (`gh workflow run` that commit) is the right fix, so this does not block. Fix: either return the parents only when there are two or more (`shas[:1] if len(shas) == 2 else shas`), or amend I7b and the I12 table to say any commit's parents. Blast radius: verdict code and stderr hint only. Nothing is published either way.
